dsp GenModalTineSoftShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 6.27 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.08 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 17.55 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.2206

dsp GenModalTineMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 6.27 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.08 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 17.55 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.2262

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))

    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))

    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 6.27 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.08 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))

    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 17.55 / sr))

    set previous := gate

dsp GenModalCowbellSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.8 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.48 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.66 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 0.9288

dsp GenModalCowbellMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.8 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.48 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.66 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 0.9194

dsp GenModalCowbellHardRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.8 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.48 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 2.66 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 0.9353

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.25 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31

    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)

    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))

    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.9 / sr))

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.25 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.6 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.9 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.0739

dsp GenModalWoodBlockMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.25 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.6 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.9 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.0817

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.25 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.6 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.25 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 4.9 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.0700

dsp GenModalSingingBowlSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 7.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.71 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.13 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.27 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1473

  param life : Seconds @control := 7.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.71 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.13 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.27 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate

dsp GenModalSingingBowlMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 7.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.71 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.13 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.27 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1451

dsp GenModalSingingBowlHardShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 7.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.71 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.13 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.27 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1332

dsp GenPluckNoneSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let pre := (wave) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.5707

dsp GenPluckNoneSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let pre := (wave) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.5530

dsp GenPluckNoneBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let pre := (wave) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.9062

dsp GenPluckNoneBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let pre := (wave) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.8861

  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]

    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)

    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 240.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))

    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 240.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs

    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.9804

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 240.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4905

dsp GenPluckMandolinBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 240.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4759

dsp GenPluckOudSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 110.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 280.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3465

dsp GenPluckOudSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 110.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 280.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3316

dsp GenPluckOudBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 110.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 280.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7205

dsp GenPluckOudBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 110.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 280.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7045

dsp GenPluckDulcimerSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 330.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 990.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.0271

dsp GenPluckDulcimerSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 330.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 990.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.0164

dsp GenPluckDulcimerBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 330.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 990.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5320

dsp GenPluckDulcimerBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 330.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 990.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5204

dsp GenPluckGuitarSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 98.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 204.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp

dsp GenPluckGuitarSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0

    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 98.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 204.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3614
